$description: GameBuddy cross-platform design contract for implementation agents. Token leaves use DTCG-style $type/$value fields.

productContext.summary: GameBuddy is a gaming agent centered on search. Players ask game questions using screenshots, gameplay clips, or text to get useful, context-relevant answers.
productContext.coreExperience: Show GameBuddy what you see, ask what you want to know, and get useful answers through search.
productContext.experiencePrinciple: Quiet companionship without interruption; help appears when needed.
productContext.gameScope: Support questions across games. Honor of Kings and Teamfight Tactics coaching are additional capabilities, not the product's defining promise.
productContext.visualPrinciple: Neutral surfaces, restrained translucent overlays, Odyssey brand identity, and localized Signal colors for status.

veil.$description: Theme-adaptive contrast overlays: black in Light, white in Dark. Higher steps increase opacity. Use low steps for subtle tints and boundaries; higher steps for stronger overlays. These are not opaque HUD background colors.

signal.$description: Localized gameplay and system status colors. Never use signal color as a dominant app surface.

gray.$description: Unavailable, stale, or uncertain / 不可用、信息过期或不确定

hudLight.$description: Explicitly light HUD surface in either app mode. Pair with fixed dark content.

hudHighContrast.$description: Explicit black HUD fallback in both modes; pair with content/onDark.

hudVeil.$description: Substantial HUD surface, independent of Veil contrast overlays. Preserves the established Light/Dark surface treatment.

onDark.$description: Fixed white content on explicitly dark surfaces.

onLight.$description: Fixed dark content on explicitly light surfaces.

subtle.$description: Adaptive boundary: dark on light surfaces, light on dark surfaces.

resting.$description: Adaptive boundary: dark on light surfaces, light on dark surfaces.

strong.$description: Adaptive boundary: dark on light surfaces, light on dark surfaces.

dark.$description: Fixed dark boundary for explicitly light surfaces.

onPrimary.$description: Fixed dark text and icons on Odyssey/4 in both modes.

odyssey.$description: GameBuddy brand palette. These UI mode pairs preserve roles rather than a continuous dark-mode ramp. Use original Light values for theme-independent brand artwork.

spectrumStroke.$description: Gradient stroke extracted from the Figma app icon. Reserve the full spectrum for launch, onboarding, and editorial brand moments—not gameplay status.

assetInventory.rule: Brand assets are managed separately from interface icons. Do not recreate the pixel wordmark with a UI font.

16.$description: Default component or mobile page padding

spacing.$description: Nominal platform-independent spacing values. Use dp on Android, pt on Apple platforms, and epx on Windows.

radius.$description: Canonical documented radius scale. Values are nominal dp/pt/epx.

xl.$description: Modals, sheets, and prominent HUD panels

full.$description: Pills, avatars, status dots, and floating controls

fontFamily.$description: Android uses the device system UI font and OS language/glyph fallback for every script. Apple and Windows retain their platform/script mappings. Semantic type metrics remain shared.

latin.$description: English and other supported Latin text

systemFallback.$description: Base UI family; let the OS manage unsupported-glyph fallback

androidPolicy.meaning: Use the platform default UI font selector, not a literal font family named system-default.
androidPolicy.fallback: Let Android resolve glyphs and locale-appropriate fonts for Chinese, Latin and other scripts, including OEM-provided system fonts.
androidPolicy.restriction: Do not force or bundle Roboto/Noto for ordinary Android UI. This policy overrides font-family names in legacy component snapshots.
androidPolicy.metrics: Keep semantic font sizes, line heights, requested weights and tracking rules. Allow content to wrap or grow when system font metrics differ; respect system text scaling.

app.$description: Shared semantic type scale. Sizes map to px in Figma, sp on Android, pt on Apple platforms, and epx on Windows. Apply the platform- and script-appropriate font family above.

lg.$description: Hero statement or onboarding moment; use sparingly

lg-lite.$description: Light-weight large display text / 轻字重大号展示文字

md-lite.$description: Light-weight medium display text / 轻字重中号展示文字

xl.$description: Large reading copy or prominent body

sm.$description: Nonessential metadata only; never essential gameplay information

component.$description: Component-scoped tokens published in Figma. Use these only for the named component family; use foundation and semantic tokens elsewhere.

sharedSource.rule: Use GB icon artwork across application UI on all platforms. Export vector paths; do not substitute a system icon library or glyph font.

android.customOutput: VectorDrawable XML or Compose ImageVector derived from GB artwork

apple.customOutput: Vector assets derived from GB artwork

windows.customOutput: SVG or WinUI vector paths derived from GB artwork

customGeometry.rule: Preserve each GB icon's authored paths, optical bounds, fills and strokes. Do not force all icons to a uniform stroke or redraw from their names.
customGeometry.defaultRendering: Tintable vector, except explicitly multicolor artwork.

$extensions.source: prior design-system working context; absent from Figma

distance.$description: Nominal platform-independent travel distances; map to dp, pt, or epx.

colorModes.resolution: For each token, select $extensions.modes[activeMode] when present; otherwise use $value. Resolve any {path} alias recursively in the same active mode. $value retains the Light default for existing consumers. This modes extension is specific to the GameBuddy token format.
colorModes.alpha: Eight-digit hex uses #RRGGBBAA. Embedded alpha is already included; do not multiply it by the informational alpha extension again.
colorModes.surfaceContext: Choose foreground treatment for the actual surface. Explicitly light HUD panels use light-surface content even in a dark app.
colorModes.componentColors: Component colors without mode overrides remain fixed; do not automatically invert them.

brandRules: Odyssey identifies GameBuddy; use Signal for gameplay and system states.
Odyssey/4 is #7E8FFF in both modes and uses fixed dark foreground content.
Use the original Odyssey palette for logos and brand artwork; UI mode pairs apply to interface roles.
materialRules: Veil opacity describes material strength, not urgency.
Do not rely on backdrop blur for legibility; provide an opaque or high-contrast fallback.
Test composited text and icon contrast over actual gameplay captures.
Transparency alone does not define an edge; use a boundary, tonal underlay, or restrained elevation.
signalRules: Resting UI is colorless or nearly colorless.
Use one dominant signal tone for one state.
Apply signal color to a partial ring, edge, dot, icon, or compact progress segment—not an entire HUD panel.
Never communicate meaning by color alone.
Coral is reserved for actual critical danger or destructive action.
The full spectrum is brand decoration, never a gameplay status display.
typographyRules: On Android, use the device system UI font and OS language/glyph fallback for all scripts; do not require Roboto or bundled Noto fonts. On Apple and Windows, use the configured platform/script mappings. Preserve one semantic type scale.
Use the published tracking values for Latin text; override tracking to zero for Chinese and mixed-language UI unless language testing approves additional spacing.
Use sentence case for English UI copy.
Use tabular figures for changing or vertically aligned metrics.
Never use text below 12 platform-scaled units for essential information.
Do not use the pixel wordmark as a UI typeface.
iconRules: Use GB Icons for application-owned UI across platforms.
Keep icon IDs stable and preserve the supplied vector geometry.
Tint icons by semantic role and actual background; keep visual size separate from hit target.
Export vectors rather than rendering layer names or private-use font glyphs.
OS-owned dialogs, permissions and share sheets retain OS-controlled visuals.
motionRules: Use one transition to attract attention, then become still.
Do not use continuous pulsing, glowing, or looping decoration during gameplay.
Meaning must remain clear with motion disabled.
Reduced motion removes travel and scale; preserve state changes with opacity or immediate replacement.
Prefer platform-native easing until canonical easing tokens are added to Figma.
gamebuddy.componentContract: Read components.json for current component variants and behavior. Component-specific tokens override broad usage suggestions for that component. Legacy groups are retained for migration only.
